regions.merged_text: Many, many thanks for your helping in the good work in office these last few years, and again for your sending me those things - package after package - since I came East. We had our Retreat this year -- last two weeks -- in the Immaculate Conception Monastery. Thanks be to God it was ideal weather and the location could hardly be surpased. Bonaventure and all send best wishes. Brother . . my shins etc. are really doing fine; Tell Br. Rufin bother me very little. Thank God . . . Am trying to keep my conscience at least as good as the same old shins .
